news.headline: Back at practice again, Bengals QB Burrow optimistic he'll be at full strength
news.detail: A full participant at practice for the second straight day despite the bug that he has battled, Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is optimistic that he'll be at full strength when Cincinnati plays the Washington Commanders on "Monday Night Football."

news.headline: Burrow is managing what the Bengals list as an illness, but the QB was a full participant in Thursday's practice and is
news.detail: Burrow is managing what the Bengals list as an illness, but the QB was a full participant in Thursday's practice and is trending toward approaching Monday night's game without a Week 11 designation. Official confirmation of that expected outcome will arrive Saturday, either way.
